top_signals.title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
top_signals.summary: Campus Moms, smuggling butter, bringing iced coffee to a job interview, and the 'what's for dinner' question: Join Alexis Christoforous, David Gura and Christina Ruffini for a roundup of headlines you may have missed, but gotta see. (Source: Bloomberg)
